decks.title: Spark
decks.description: Playful truths, dares, and what-if prompts to kick off date night.

cards.prompt: What was your first impression of me, and what surprised you most later?
Recreate our best kiss in slow motion like it belongs in a movie trailer.
Would you rather plan a spontaneous midnight road trip or a luxury stay-in date with candles and cocktails?

decks.title: Confessions
decks.description: A deeper deck for romantic honesty, flirty tension, and a little vulnerability.

cards.prompt: What do I do that instantly makes you feel wanted?
Give me a 30-second pep talk about why we are irresistible together.
Describe a fantasy date night that starts elegant and ends much less innocent.

decks.title: After Dark
decks.description: Adult-only prompts designed for couples who want the heat turned all the way up.

cards.prompt: Whisper exactly how you want the next ten minutes of our night to go.
What outfit or look of mine lives in your head rent-free when you want to flirt with me?
